en.template: Compare staying micro, EI au réel, EURL and SASU for {activity}, {household}, {prior}, {projected}, {vat}, {rfr}, and {cash}. Separate annualized tax illustrations from actual cash timing. Compare dividend barème/PFU choices and flag unconfirmed social treatment, future rates and fees. Help me prepare questions for my accountant; do not access accounts, file returns or incorporate anything.

phases.title: Gather the official rates and rules for staying micro, an EURL and a SASU
phases.judgment: It kept official facts apart from its own inference. The flat tax on dividends is 31.4% in 2026, not the 30% still quoted on blogs. No official 2027 change was found, so 2027 is marked unconfirmed, and a net-pay ratio it derived itself is labelled “not official”.

workers: Collected the official 2026 rates: company tax, the flat tax on dividends, social contributions for a company president and an EURL manager, registration costs, and the micro-entrepreneur contribution rules
